assessment_objectives.objective: the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) held, managed or processed by each applicable third-party that must be transferred, migrated or made available upon cessation of services are identified.

contractual and/or technical provisions exist that require applicable Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) to be made available in a documented, usable format that can be consumed by a replacement third-party or internally-managed service.
the transfer or migration of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) from a third-party uses protected channels and/or encryption consistent with the classification of the data.
the completeness and integrity of transferred or migrated Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) are verified before the third-party services cease.

the ability to transfer or migrate applicable Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) is tested or otherwise validated before it is relied upon during a cessation of third-party services.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually for critical third-party relationships
